_contract: Everything B-E's verdict depends on, fixed before the session: the probe, the numeric identity, every threshold and the engine settings. scripts/stages/stage-1/projected_residual/engineering_validation.py :: verdict re-derives every check from the evidence and this file alone. Engineering only: nothing measured here is a result, a selection or a GO, and no student it builds is kept.

smoke.recipe: configs/stages/stage-2/reasoning_data/h1pa.json :: recipe.e1_configs.20260726 (D4-Augmented's E1 config for the smoke seed) plus the \.projection$ trainable pattern; sequence length, batch size, micro-batch, bf16 autocast and gradient checkpointing as the recipe has them
smoke.data: synthetic token sequences (seeded): a smoke measures the training step's shape, time and memory, not learning

probe._: real eval-set-1 prompts from safe reasoning components only (no safety, answerability or knowledge item), rendered as the evaluation route renders them: run_battery's system message, the item's messages, the Thinking-2507 template with its generation prompt (which opens <think>), tokenized without special tokens. The token ids are recomputed on the pod and must hash to these values; the evidence records ids and hashes, never prompt text
probe._tiny: the host path's tiny teacher has a 97-token vocabulary, so its probe is seeded random ids of these lengths; it rehearses the code, never the numbers

numeric_identity._device_class: matched as a substring of torch.cuda.get_device_name; a different card is recorded and FAILS the device-bound checks: the formal route runs on the L40S
numeric_identity._tf32: torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 and torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32 set False before any CUDA work, so float32 is float32
numeric_identity._deterministic: torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True, warn_only=True) with CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG set before CUDA initializes; kernels with no deterministic implementation warn rather than abort, and the resume check measures what remains

structural_fold._: materialize.py's check: max |factored - folded| / max |logit| on the CPU in float32. A transposed or misplaced projection moves logits by their own magnitude (relative ~1); a correct fold by float32 rounding through 28 layers (relative 1e-6 to 1e-4). 1e-3 sits between the two

fold_acceptance.criterion: on the L40S, over the whole probe: max |folded_bf16 - factored_bf16| <= factor x max |factored_bf16 - factored_fp32|
diagnostics_not_criteria: the float32 fold difference on the device

resume.criterion: the run resumed from a mid-run checkpoint ends with parameters bit-identical to the uninterrupted run's
resume.kernel_nondeterminism: if they differ, a second uninterrupted run measures the device's own run-to-run difference; the check then PASSES only if the resumed run differs from the first uninterrupted run by no more than the two uninterrupted runs differ from each other (P5: the nondeterministic source is logged, not hidden), and FAILS otherwise or if the uninterrupted runs agree

vllm._: an engineering load and consistency check of the evaluation route's engine on the folded checkpoint: not a measurement, not a P18 evaluation, no score and no GO. Generation is greedy and bounded because nothing here judges what is generated; the bound is declared, not a measurement allowance
vllm.engine: vLLM 0.27.1 in /opt/vllm (requirements-vllm.txt), its own process, after the PyTorch checks' process has exited (shared.validation.vllm_check.run_isolated)

context.rule: shared.evaluation.uncapped_eval.resolve_context(folded config, None, trained_context): the formal evaluation's own resolution (H1-PA evaluation :: trained_context 8,192)

vllm.stop: the evaluation's stop ids (uncapped_eval.resolve_stop_ids on the teacher's tokenizer and config)
vllm.reference: the folded checkpoint's saved bytes loaded as a stock Qwen3ForCausalLM on the L40S in bfloat16 (sdpa): per prompt position, the log-probability of the realized next token, the argmax and the top-1 margin over the second token
vllm._criteria: two bf16 implementations of the same weights (HF sdpa and the engine's kernels) differ by accumulation order: realized-token log-probabilities move by hundredths of a nat and only near-ties change their argmax. A wrong weight mapping, RoPE base, norm, head layout or tied head moves them by nats and flips confident predictions. So: the median |delta| over every prompt position must not exceed 0.1 nats, and where the reference's top-1 leads its second by at least 1 nat the engine must agree on at least 98% of at least 20 such positions. Fixed before any measurement; a FAIL is an engineering finding to diagnose, not a result
structural: every echoed prompt_token_ids equals the request's
every request generates at least one token and records its finish reason (stop or length)
the engine ran at the resolved max_model_len

gpu_isolation.criterion: the PyTorch checks' child process exited before the engine started, the parent never imported torch, and nvidia-smi showed no compute process and at most max_used_mib_before_engine MiB in use when the engine was started
